reading: Centered faucet mounting set: manual post-publication mesh review
scope: Location-specific STEP face readings and the saved STL lint output. Local inward lines are not a complete-face thickness, load-capacity or lifetime qualification. The centered printed set and steel plate have no physical fit acceptance.

method.native_face_indices: Zero-based face order of the hash-bound STEP, loaded by CadQuery. Nearest faces within 0.03 mm of each first lint pick are included; the smallest-distance face is first.
method.inward_material_intervals: Distances in mm from the native face point along its inward normal, determined by exact line intersections and solid classification, with a 40 mm reading limit. A listed interval ending at 39.99 mm reaches that reading limit.
method.lint_timing: All nine pieces were linted after their published hashes were verified. Only the changed tip was linted again after its corrected published hash was verified. Answer coverage uses the saved output and the tool's own exact anchor matcher.
method.mesh_scope: Watertightness and winding readings describe the STL topology; they do not establish print finish or physical strength.
